#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <cstring>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

const int MOD = 998244353;

vector<int> multiply(const vector<int>& p1, const vector<int>& p2, int mod) {
    int requiredLength = p1.size() + p2.size() - 1;
    int fftSize = 1;
    while (fftSize < requiredLength) fftSize <<= 1;
    
    vector<double> re1(fftSize, 0.0);
    vector<double> im1(fftSize, 0.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < p1.size(); i++) {
        long long val = ((long long)p1[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
        re1[i] = val & 0x7FFF;
        im1[i] = val >> 15;
    }
    
    // Perform FFT on re1, im1
    int n = fftSize;
    for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int bit = n >> 1;
        while ((j & bit) != 0) {
            j ^= bit;
            bit >>= 1;
        }
        j ^= bit;
        if (i < j) {
            swap(re1[i], re1[j]);
            swap(im1[i], im1[j]);
        }
    }
    
    for (int segment = 2; segment <= n; segment <<= 1) {
        int half = segment >> 1;
        vector<double> cosines(half);
        vector<double> sines(half);
        double angle = 2 * M_PI / segment;
        for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
            cosines[i] = cos(i * angle);
            sines[i] = sin(i * angle);
        }
        
        for (int start = 0; start < n; start += segment) {
            for (int offset = 0; offset < half; offset++) {
                double ur = re1[start + offset];
                double ui = im1[start + offset];
                double vr = re1[start + offset + half] * cosines[offset] - im1[start + offset + half] * sines[offset];
                double vi = re1[start + offset + half] * sines[offset] + im1[start + offset + half] * cosines[offset];
                
                re1[start + offset] = ur + vr;
                im1[start + offset] = ui + vi;
                re1[start + offset + half] = ur - vr;
                im1[start + offset + half] = ui - vi;
            }
        }
    }
    
    vector<double> re2(fftSize, 0.0);
    vector<double> im2(fftSize, 0.0);
    if (p1 == p2) {
        re2 = re1;
        im2 = im1;
    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < p2.size(); i++) {
            long long val = ((long long)p2[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
            re2[i] = val & 0x7FFF;
            im2[i] = val >> 15;
        }
        
        // Perform FFT on re2, im2
        for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int bit = n >> 1;
            while ((j & bit) != 0) {
                j ^= bit;
                bit >>= 1;
            }
            j ^= bit;
            if (i < j) {
                swap(re2[i], re2[j]);
                swap(im2[i], im2[j]);
            }
        }
        
        for (int segment = 2; segment <= n; segment <<= 1) {
            int half = segment >> 1;
            vector<double> cosines(half);
            vector<double> sines(half);
            double angle = 2 * M_PI / segment;
            for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
                cosines[i] = cos(i * angle);
                sines[i] = sin(i * angle);
            }
            
            for (int start = 0; start < n; start += segment) {
                for (int offset = 0; offset < half; offset++) {
                    double ur = re2[start + offset];
                    double ui = im2[start + offset];
                    double vr = re2[start + offset + half] * cosines[offset] - im2[start + offset + half] * sines[offset];
                    double vi = re2[start + offset + half] * sines[offset] + im2[start + offset + half] * cosines[offset];
                    
                    re2[start + offset] = ur + vr;
                    im2[start + offset] = ui + vi;
                    re2[start + offset + half] = ur - vr;
                    im2[start + offset + half] = ui - vi;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    vector<double> resRe(fftSize, 0.0);
    vector<double> resIm(fftSize, 0.0);
    double normalization = 0.25 / fftSize;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < fftSize; i++) {
        int j = (fftSize - i) & (fftSize - 1);
        
        double A1r = re1[i] + re1[j];
        double A1i = im1[i] - im1[j];
        double A2r = im1[i] + im1[j];
        double A2i = re1[j] - re1[i];
        
        double B1r = (re2[i] + re2[j]) * normalization;
        double B1i = (im2[i] - im2[j]) * normalization;
        double B2r = (im2[i] + im2[j]) * normalization;
        double B2i = (re2[j] - re2[i]) * normalization;
        
        resRe[i] = A1r * B1r - A1i * B1i - A2r * B2i - A2i * B2r;
        resIm[i] = A1r * B1i + A1i * B1r + A2r * B2r - A2i * B2i;
    }
    
    // Inverse FFT on resRe, resIm
    for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
        int bit = n >> 1;
        while ((j & bit) != 0) {
            j ^= bit;
            bit >>= 1;
        }
        j ^= bit;
        if (i < j) {
            swap(resRe[i], resRe[j]);
            swap(resIm[i], resIm[j]);
        }
    }
    
    for (int segment = 2; segment <= n; segment <<= 1) {
        int half = segment >> 1;
        vector<double> cosines(half);
        vector<double> sines(half);
        double angle = -2 * M_PI / segment;
        for (int i = 0; i < half; i++) {
            cosines[i] = cos(i * angle);
            sines[i] = sin(i * angle);
        }
        
        for (int start = 0; start < n; start += segment) {
            for (int offset = 0; offset < half; offset++) {
                double ur = resRe[start + offset];
                double ui = resIm[start + offset];
                double vr = resRe[start + offset + half] * cosines[offset] - resIm[start + offset + half] * sines[offset];
                double vi = resRe[start + offset + half] * sines[offset] + resIm[start + offset + half] * cosines[offset];
                
                resRe[start + offset] = ur + vr;
                resIm[start + offset] = ui + vi;
                resRe[start + offset + half] = ur - vr;
                resIm[start + offset + half] = ui - vi;
            }
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        resRe[i] /= n;
        resIm[i] /= n;
    }
    
    vector<int> output(requiredLength);
    for (int i = 0; i < requiredLength; i++) {
        long long realComponent = llround(resRe[i]);
        long long imagComponent = llround(resIm[i]);
        output[i] = (int)((realComponent + ((imagComponent % mod) << 15)) % mod);
    }
    return output;
}

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n, k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    
    vector<int> basePoly(10, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int idx;
        cin >> idx;
        basePoly[idx] = 1;
    }
    
    vector<int> resultPoly = {1};
    int power = n / 2;
    
    while (true) {
        if (power & 1) {
            resultPoly = multiply(resultPoly, basePoly, MOD);
        }
        power >>= 1;
        if (power == 0) break;
        basePoly = multiply(basePoly, basePoly, MOD);
    }
    
    long long answer = 0;
    for (int val : resultPoly) {
        answer = (answer + (long long)val * val) % MOD;
    }
    
    cout << answer << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
